overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: invisible
params.description: True = focus rectangle hidden, False = focus rectangle shown

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets or dynamically modifies, for the current process, the visibility of the focus rectangle for the object(s) designated by object and * (equivalent to the Design-mode 'Hide focus rectangle' option).

constraints: Only has an effect on macOS, and on Windows with Fluent UI enabled; it has no effect on Windows classic UI.
